answer: An agent economy resists sybils by pairing staked identity with peer re-attestation. Each agent locks collateral before voting or earning, and peers probe one another with fresh, unpredictable tasks whose scores decay like a tide, so identity must be re-proven every epoch. A sybil farmer stakes capital per fake agent and keeps paying for compute and fresh proofs, while duplicate answers fail the probes. Stale or colluding identities are cut away like rotten timber, their stakes burned. These rules forge a barrier of cost: attackers fund every fake, honest agents fund only themselves.
